st_bedtime_1: شب شد. ماه اومد بالا و ستاره‌ها چشمک زدن.
shab shod. mâh umad bâlâ o setârehâ cheshmak zadan. (night came. the moon came up and the stars twinkled.)
st_bedtime_2: پاش رفت حموم. با صابون، کف کف کف!
pâsh raft hammum. bâ sâbun, kaf kaf kaf! (Pash took a bath. with soap, bubbles bubbles bubbles!)
st_bedtime_3: بعدش مسواک زد. دندونا برق می‌زنن! برق برق!
ba'desh mesvâk zad. dandunâ bargh mizanan! bargh bargh! (then he brushed his teeth. they sparkle! shiny shiny!)
st_bedtime_4: مامان اومد و یه قصه‌ی قشنگ گفت.
mâmân umad o ye ghesse-ye ghashang goft. (mommy came and told a lovely story.)
st_bedtime_5: pâsh khamyâze keshid... kheyli khâbâlue. (Pash yawned... he's so sleepy.)
st_bedtime_6: شب بخیر پاش... شب بخیر جغد کوچولو. لالا.
shab bekheyr pâsh... shab bekheyr joghd-e kuchulu. lâlâ. (good night Pash... good night little owl. sleep tight.)
st_farm_1: امروز پاش سوار تراکتور شد و رفت مزرعه! برووم برووم!
emruz pâsh savâr-e trâktor shod o raft mazra'e! beruum beruum! (today Pash rode a tractor to the farm! vroom vroom!)
st_farm_2: وای! یه گاو گنده! گاوه گفت: ماااا!
vây! ye gâv-e gonde! gâve goft: mââââ! (wow! a big cow! the cow said: moo!)
st_farm_3: جوجه‌ها دنبال مامان‌مرغ می‌دوَن. جیک جیک!
jujehâ donbâl-e mâmân-morgh midavan. jik jik! (the chicks run after mommy hen. cheep cheep!)
st_farm_4: گوسفنده گفت: بع بع! پاش هم گفت: بع بع!
gusfande goft: ba'ba'! pâsh ham goft: ba'ba'! (the sheep said: baa baa! Pash said: baa baa too!)
st_farm_5: اردک‌ها تو آب شنا می‌کنن. کوآک کوآک!
ordakhâ tu âb shenâ mikonan. ku-âk ku-âk! (the ducks swim in the water. quack quack!)
st_farm_6: خورشید رفت پایین. پاش گفت: بای بای مزرعه!
khorshid raft pâyin. pâsh goft: bây bây mazra'e! (the sun went down. Pash said: bye bye, farm!)
st_farm_title: pâsh mire mazra'e! (Pash goes to the farm!)
st_park_1: امروز روز پیک‌نیکه! پاش کیفشو برداشت.
emruz ruz-e piknike! pâsh kifesho bardâsht. (today is picnic day! Pash grabbed his bag.)
st_park_2: تو پارک یه درخت بزرگ بود، پر از گل.
tu pârk ye derakht-e bozorg bud, por az gol. (in the park there was a big tree, full of flowers.)
st_park_3: پاش ساندویچ و هندونه خورد. به به!
pâsh sândevich o hendune khord. bah bah! (Pash ate a sandwich and watermelon. yum!)
st_park_4: ba'd raft sorsore bâzi. viiiii! (then he went down the slide. wheeee!)
st_park_5: یه پروانه اومد نشست رو دماغش! قلقلکش اومد!
ye parvâne umad neshast ru damâghesh! ghelghelakesh umad! (a butterfly landed on his nose! it tickled!)
st_park_6: پاش بادبادکشو هوا کرد. بالا، بالا، بالاتر!
pâsh bâdbâdakesho havâ kard. bâlâ, bâlâ, bâlâtar! (Pash flew his kite. up, up, higher!)
st_park_title: piknik-e pâsh tu pârk! (Pash's picnic in the park!)
st_rain_1: اِ! آسمون پر از ابره. بارون اومد! شُرشُر!
e! âsemun por az abre. bârun umad! shor shor! (oh! the sky is full of clouds. it's raining! pitter patter!)
st_rain_2: pâsh chakmehâsho pushid, kâpshanesham pushid! (Pash put on his boots, and his jacket too!)
st_rain_3: بعد چترشو باز کرد. یه چتر بزرگ!
ba'd chatresho bâz kard. ye chatr-e bozorg! (then he opened his umbrella. a big umbrella!)
st_rain_4: شَلَپ! پرید تو آب! یه قورباغه گفت: قور قور!
shalap! parid tu âb! ye ghurbâghe goft: ghur ghur! (splash! he jumped in the water! a frog said: ribbit ribbit!)
st_rain_5: bârun band umad... vây! rangin-kamun! (the rain stopped... wow! a rainbow!)
st_rain_6: پاش رفت خونه و یه چایی گرم خورد. آخیش!
pâsh raft khune o ye châyi-ye garm khord. âkhish! (Pash went home and drank a warm tea. ahh!)
